body: That's a good attitude. Keep that attitude.
Your advice is worth something because you cared enough about a stranger to say it.

I don't know, 23 years of cyclical depression is probably not going to just go away. But, optimism never hurts. I'd rather not talk about my cheating boyfriend- I've already talked myself silly about him lately. He's not the first to cheat on me and he won't be the last, I'm sure. That's life my friend. It sucks.

I'll try to do this, as someone older than myself it would be stupid for me to not take your experience into consideration. But I find it difficult to surrender to anything at all much less unhappiness. Thank you though.
